lines: Shizuku, face up on the ground, had Library's red-hot blade pointed straight at his neck.
In this position, he could burn off his head at any time.
It was decided in a matter of moments.
The Animal Taimanin, controlled by the "Drops of Darkness", simultaneously pounced on Library from all directions.
Library was not the least bit panicked.
He handled every claw that swung down at him, every fang that thrust at him and counterattacked by sending their heads flying one after the other.
The Animal Taimanin, just like how they had attacked, all fell in unison.
Just what I'd expected, old man!
Library had no way to avoid the surprise attack of Shizuku, who appeared from the "Drops of Darkness" that had been set on the ground.
His deadly energy blades completely caught hold of Library's mechanical body.
Shizuku's voice rose in an innocent shout of joy.
However, Shizuku had completely neglected the basicsー
In a battle between Taimanin, the most important fundamental rule was to understand your opponent's Ninja Arts.
Perhaps he'd underestimated Library's Ninja Art because he was a cyborg Taimanin.
He thought all Library could do was turn invisible.
He'd neglected analyzing the nature of Library's Ninja Art to figure out how it allowed him to disappear.
Perhaps it was his innate talent that made him careless.
That became the reason for Shizuku's loss.
Library's body, which the energy blades should have penetrated, had crystallized.
His silicon crystal body, which excelled at heat resistance and was raw optical fiber material, had completely absorbed and dispersed the blades' energy.
So your Ninja Art turns your body into silicon. I'm surprised, mister.
Shizuku spoke with the red-hot blade thrust before his neck.
You're quite knowledgeable to be able to immediately understand my Ninja Art from looking at my crystallized body.
I'm afraid there is no tomorrow, boy. That's the world of the shinobi.
There was a slight pause in his reply.
As if to show his hesitation...
Then why don't you kill me right now?
You're strong, mister, but too soft.
It was a smile from the bottom of the boy's heart, not the fake one he'd put on before.
The blade of Library, who had to finish him off as the leader of the Oniwaban, trembled slightly.
A Dark Shinobi Snake that was still alive attacked him.
Library warded off the surprise attack of the Dark Shinobi Snake and lopped off its head with a single blow.
But taking advantage of that opening, Shizuku had managed to escape into the darkness.
『Gaiza-sama was right. I'm still not good enough.』
『But I can still get stronger. Someday I'll kill you, mister, and your master Diot too!』
Library tried to follow after Shizuku, but Dark Animal Taimanin appeared one after the other before him.
Perhaps he'd expected the worst and left them to take up the rear.
It was easy to fight them off.
However, in the time it took to finish dealing with them, Shizuku was already nowhere to be found.
He could have killed him if he wanted to.
But knowing his father and seeing his innocent smile, he'd hesitated.
Even though he knew that the boy would appear as an even stronger enemy and aim to take his master's life once more.
It faded away into the summer breeze without being heard by anyone.
The lights of the mansion were on.
Even though the summer days were long, it was already so dark outside.
It had gotten this late while I'd been immersed in the new fighting game at Yukikaze's house.
Tokiko should have long since returned home, and even Sakura should have come back from the river.
I realized that it had become night and rushed home, but I knew I was in for a severe scolding from Tokiko.
Even though it was my own home, I was loitering around the gate and trying to take a peek at the inside, when...
Library, who was still out in the yard, called out to me.
That's a bit of an overreaction.
I laughed at his exaggerated line, but I realized that Library looked a bit different from during the day.
That aside, Library, you look a bit worn out. You weren't like that when I saw you earlier.
I simply trained on my own for a bit after and overdid it a little.
I see. Take it a little easier then, okay?
Since I'd been found, it would be strange to stay here.
I had no choice but to go inside.
I shall apologize to Tokiko-dono with you.
Huh? Really? Sorry to always hassle you.
Boys are late-night creatures. I'm aware that you were with Yukikaze-sama.
Wha!? W-We were just playing games!
Don't worry. Tokiko-dono doesn't know. I've kept it to myself.
I somehow felt intensely misunderstood about having been with Yukikaze.
But there was no time to clear up misunderstandings here.
For the moment, I could only ask Library to become a lightning rod to avoid even just a bit of Tokiko's anger.
I'm counting on you, Library. Hopefully I can end this day unscathed.
Yes. This, too, is a groundskeeper's duty.
